title: maint.event.v1{kind=quarantine_clear}
description: Phase 7 publisher hook stub / Phase 8 §8.7 — operator clears a quarantine_samples row as a false-positive. Triggers the §8.7 maint.sec FP feedback loop (which then promotes the rule hit to a per-source allowlist row, either auto-active or pending-operator-approval). Carries `target=<quarantine_id>` so storage can resolve back to (source, rule_id, hit_substring).

reason.description: Operator note explaining why the quarantine was a FP.
